Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Jim Levin, David Strah, and Michael Hirsch, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2.Discussion about gay personal relationships COMMERCIAL:Human Rights Campaign Fund Dinner 3.Discussion about ACT-UP and the changing face of gay activism COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund Dinner 4.Discussion about the conservative publication, "The Wanderer." 5.News Watch, State of California passed bills to allow tests to treat AIDS 6.Representative Gerry Studs demands an investigation on the failure of the Regan administration to properly deal with AIDS and AIDS education 7.British Medical Journal states that the HIV Virus Antibody tests can take up to 14 months for a detection 8.Milwaukee gay community protests radio station WQFM for homophobic radio show 9.Announcements about LGBT events 10.GCN Sports, Soccer team, The Ramblers win a game in Boston, Football player Rich [Syler] faces charges of second degree murder,Virgin Islands announces that they are going to field a team for the 1988 Winter Olympics 11.Lavender Heatlh, interview with Don Lorimer, Lower East Side AIDS Coordinator 12.Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1.Show Bitz, discussion about the gay play, "What's New" COMMERCIAL:The Islanders Club 2.Naming Names, criticism about the portrayal of a gay character in the movie, "No Way Out" COMMERCIAL:Human Rights Campaign Fund Dinner COMMERCIAL:The Monster 3.Razor Sharp, talks about the play, "20's, 30's, 40's", The Fetish Ball, and Raw Hide COMMERCIAL:Gay Treasures 4.GCN soap opera, "Georgia Vice," episode "Georgia Vice's Day Off" COMMERCIAL:The Monster 5. "Short Bits of Wisdom From Daddy" by Perry Brass 6.Closing Credits
